test_title: SSC CPO 2025 Official Paper (Held On 12 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Choose the correct option to rearrange the following sentences to form a coherent paragraph:

A. The new recruit saluted with nervous energy.

B. The sergeant nodded with a knowing smile.

C. He remembered his own first day on duty.

D. Time had taught him both discipline and patience.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The paragraph begins with **Sentence A**, which introduces the new recruit and sets the scene.
 
• **Sentence B follows** as the sergeant responds with a knowing smile, creating a natural flow from the recruit’s nervousness to the sergeant’s reaction.
 
• **Sentence C comes next** as the sergeant recalls his own first day, linking present action with past memory.
 
• **Sentence D concludes** the paragraph by reflecting on the discipline and patience gained over time, providing closure.
 
• Thus, the correct sequence is **ABCD**.

 

**Coherent paragraph after rearrangement**:

"The new recruit saluted with nervous energy. The sergeant nodded with a knowing smile. He remembered his own first day on duty. Time had taught him both discipline and patience."
